title: Fleet Rung 40 — THE EXCHANGE CORE: the DEX settles. The owner demanded real swaps on our own network, not lies: "חשוב שגם נוכל באמת להחליף למטבע האמיתי עם ערך ולא סתם שקר" — and opposing grids on OUR side, a networked arbitrage market, and a vault that holds real coins. R39 built the router (the venue graph, the honest verdicts). R40 builds the settlement engine itself: dex-core.cjs — an atomic, deterministic, reserve-backed exchange core on our own ledger. Two invariants, one engine: constant-product volatile pools (Uniswap v2 exact law, fee-on-input, floor to the user — the pool keeps the dust) and Curve stableswap peg pools (canonical A=10, fee-on-output with the −1 pad). A vault that mints WSTEEM/WSBD ONLY 1:1 against reserve custody actually held, where REDEEM IS ALWAYS HONORED 1:1 (burn before payout), with the conservation identity custody − wrappedReserve − Σclaims − ΣpooledReserves === 0 asserted every tick and an attestation sha256(seq, custody, reserves, minted, claims) booked so any node re-verifies. minOut atomicity on every swap (refused = state byte-unchanged). Deterministic ≤3-hop routing with exact BigInt simulation. The rebalance FLOOR law inherited from R39: when the pool's own price drifts from the CEX-implied fair beyond 2×costs, the treasury rebalances AGAINST ITS OWN POOL — we are our own LVR rebalancer and capture what outside arbitrageurs would drain; below the floor it is a plan, never a trade. Counter-grids anchored to the POOL MID — the opposing grids on OUR side of the book (R39 anchored to the CEX fair, their side). The drip-fuel loop is mechanical: the chain probe books custody deltas as DEPOSIT-DELTA ops — the powerdown lands on headcorner and enters the DEX the same hour, zero new code on drip day.

queries.Q59_what_makes_a_swap_real: three things, mechanically: (1) settlement is atomic in OUR ledger — one op, all legs posted or none; (2) the counter-value is backed — wrapped assets mint 1:1 against reserve custody that the conservation identity proves is there every tick; (3) the attestation hash recomputes from the booked fields so any node can re-verify without trusting us. A swap that fails any of the three is not booked.
queries.Q60_why_two_invariants: the research verdict (R40-d, 31 queries): stableswap on a volatile pair lets arbitrageurs drain the pool at the flat part of the curve; constant-product on a 1:1 peg wastes depth. So PEG pools (WSTEEM/STEEM, WSBD/SBD) run Curve stableswap A=10 (canonical 2020 formulation, Newton get_D/get_y, 255-iter cap, fee-on-output, the −1 pad) and the volatile pair (STEEM/SBD) runs Uniswap v2 exact BigInt math. Both audited lineages, both ported faithfully, both pinned by E63 against independent re-derivations (the invariant equation evaluated in floats, a bisection solve that shares NO code with the Newton solver).
queries.Q61_how_does_the_drip_become_liquidity: the measure phase probes headcorner's liquid balances each tick and books the delta as a DEPOSIT-DELTA op with provenance — chain is ground truth. When the powerdown pays (2026-10-10, 470.84 SP/week ×13 measured), custody jumps, the op books, the treasury claim grows, and the next genesis-share laws deploy it into pools. No code runs on drip day — the loop is already wired. A custody DROP (never expected with our keys) halts trading for the tick: the vault never trades on shrinking custody.
queries.Q62_what_is_the_opposing_grid_on_our_net: R39's counter-grids anchor to the CEX-implied fair (their side of the book). R40's anchor to the POOL MID — our network's own price — with the same Avellaneda inventory skew (sign from the pool's own inventory share: a STEEM-heavy pool shifts the ladder down to favor sells) and the same spacing law (max(vol×0.1, 0.4% floor)). Booked PLAN-POOL-GATED-NOT-BROADCAST — the same law as R39: the plan is visible, the broadcast stays with the gated signing surfaces.
queries.Q63_who_arbitrages_our_own_pool: we do — that is the LVR defense (Milionis-Moallemi-Roughgarden-Zhang: an AMM's loss to arbitrageurs is what a rebalancing desk would have captured). When the pool drifts from the CEX-implied fair beyond the R39 FLOOR law (net must beat 2×costs), the treasury sells the overvalued side INTO our own pool, paying the full fee and impact, booking the edge marked to fair at execution. Below the floor: a plan row, never a trade — the same honesty that kept A1 BELOW-FLOOR in R39. The fee meter accrues to the LP (the treasury), so the spread we would have paid an outside arb stays home.
queries.Q64_where_do_big_amounts_route: the tier law stands (R39 Q57): T0 = our internal ledger (this rung — atomic, real, ours); T1 = wrapped pools; T2 = keyed external rails (operator CEX keys, named in every gated route). The router keeps measuring the external graph hourly; the core settles the internal book. Big amounts on every network arrive when the named gates open — the doors are watched, the verdicts are honest, and nothing pretends.
queries.Q65_what_proves_determinism: the settle path is a pure function of (book, feed, injected clock): E63 re-runs it twice on identical inputs and demands byte-identical routes+ops; the selftest (fresh process, zero network) runs golden vectors, a seeded 200-swap k-fuzz, the bisection cross-check and the conservation identity — 22/22; and the booked book's attestation sha256 recomputes from its own fields inside E63 (real-tree law). Same inputs, same bytes, every run.
